“银行看重实物资产，而这些企业的资产是代码和订单，这种错配是横亘在人工智能产业商: "Banks value physical assets, while these enterprises' assets are code and orders. This mismatch is a structural problem that looms over the commercialization process of the artificial intelligence industry."
工商银行深圳龙岗支行则以“算力e贷”落地辖内首笔业务……: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Shenzhen Longgang Branch has deployed the first transaction of its "computing power e-loan"...
融资产品名称各异，但都是在围绕人工智能、数字经济等新兴产业特点，探索与企业新型经: The names of financing products vary, but all are exploring financial products and credit evaluation methods adapted to new business models of enterprises, centered around the characteristics of emerging industries such as artificial intelligence and the digital economy, transforming enterprises' "invisible computing power consumption" into banks' "visible credit basis."
“API（应用程序编程接口）调用日志、算力使用记录等数据天然不可篡改: "API (Application Programming Interface) call logs, computing power usage records and other data are inherently tamper-proof."
”戴志杰介绍，银行通过数据清洗和聚合，即可将海量原始日志转化为可视化经营报表，再: "Dai Zhijie explained that through data cleaning and aggregation, banks can transform massive raw logs into visual operational reports, and combined with cross-verification of computing power purchase contracts, downstream service contracts, and technical qualifications, break through risk control barriers that overemphasize fixed assets and physical collateral."
“算力账单”成授信锚点: "Computing Power Bill" Becomes the Anchor Point for Credit Authorization
在“词元贷”发布银行，企业贷款材料清单展示了新变化：以前是房产证、报表、发票等，: In the bank that released the "token loan," the enterprise loan materials checklist shows new changes: previously it was property certificates, financial statements, and invoices, but now it has become monthly token consumption data, computing power service contracts, and API call logs.
从看资产到看流量，将“算力账单”变成授信锚点，如何顺利落地: From looking at assets to looking at traffic, turning the "computing power bill" into a credit authorization anchor point—how can this be smoothly implemented?
在深圳市爱智慧科技有限公司，工程师正在调试喷漆机器人——机器人每“学会”一个新动: At Shenzhen AIZHIHUI Technology Co., Ltd., engineers are debugging spray painting robots—each time the robot "learns" a new action, behind it lies the invocation of large models, the consumption of tokens, and the accumulation of bills.
在走访企业时，深圳市龙岗区人工智能（机器人）署摸清行业痛点，协同区发展和改革局指: During enterprise visits, Shenzhen Longgang District's Artificial Intelligence (Robotics) Office identified industry pain points, and coordinated with the District Development and Reform Bureau to guide Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Shenzhen Longgang Branch to introduce the "computing power e-loan," incorporating computing power procurement needs, technology service contract value, and future receivable accounts into the credit assessment system, quickly approving AIZHIHUI Technology a credit loan limit of 5 million yuan.
“这笔贷款来得非常及时，不仅解决了购买算力的资金难题，更是对我们这类轻资产科创企: "This loan came at a very timely moment, not only solving the funding difficulties in purchasing computing power, but also representing great recognition of the value of our light-asset scientific innovation enterprise."
不同的企业，“算力账单”的计算方式不同，银行授信的尺子也不同: For different enterprises, the calculation methods for the "computing power bill" differ, and banks' credit authorization "measuring sticks" also differ.
”广州一家AI（人工智能）短剧制作企业的营销负责人梁剑算了一笔账: "The marketing director of an AI short-drama production enterprise in Guangzhou, Liang Jian, made a calculation."
以日常算力消耗数据作参考依据，这家企业申请到500万元3年期信用贷款: Using daily computing power consumption data as a reference basis, this enterprise obtained a 5 million yuan three-year credit loan.
而另一家AI电商直播企业面临的难题则是，算力采购款须提前垫付，项目回款周期长达5: Meanwhile, another AI e-commerce livestreaming enterprise faces a different challenge: computing power purchase payments must be advanced, with project payment cycles lasting 5 to 6 months.
凭借算力采购单，该企业获得300万元3年期信用授信: Based on computing power purchase orders, the enterprise obtained 3 million yuan in three-year credit authorization.
中国银行广州分行将企业历史词元结算数据、词元供给值与消耗值以及算力合约价值作为经: Bank of China Guangzhou Branch takes enterprises' historical token settlement data, token supply and consumption values, and computing power contract value as important considerations in operational evaluation, launching three "token loan" sub-products: computing power supply loan, serving enterprises engaged in large model construction and training, having completed national-level filing and signed computing power service contracts.
算力应用贷，服务使用词元发展自身业务的发展型企业: Computing power application loan, serving developing enterprises that use tokens to develop their own business.
算力服务贷，服务提供AI API服务、数据标注、模型微调的技术服务商: Computing power service loan, serving technology service providers that offer AI API services, data annotation, and model fine-tuning.
下游看消耗与订单，考察AI应用是否顺利从样品迈向产品: Downstream, looking at consumption and orders, assessing whether AI applications are successfully transitioning from prototypes to products.
中间则看算力平台方的结算流水: In the middle, examining the settlement flow of the computing power platform operator.
“通过算力消耗的相关情况去看客户的真实经营生产，让授信逻辑逐步向动态数据监测转化: "By observing the relevant computing power consumption situation, we can see the customer's actual business and production, allowing the credit logic to gradually shift toward dynamic data monitoring."
把“看不见的算力消耗”变成“看得见的信用依据”，新尺子也带来一些新风险: Transforming "invisible computing power consumption" into "visible credit basis," the new measuring stick also brings some new risks.
此外，词元价格随着人工智能大模型调用需求情况和算力市场变化波动，作为授信锚点是否: Additionally, token prices fluctuate with changes in artificial intelligence large model invocation demand and computing power market conditions—is using this as a credit authorization anchor point reliable?
银行参照企业历史算力结算数据、算力服务合约价值、算力业务应收账款、词元佣金结算量: Banks reference enterprises' historical computing power settlement data, computing power service contract value, computing power business receivable accounts, token commission settlement amounts, and combined with dimensions such as enterprise operations, finance, credit record, and actual controller background, determine enterprises' comprehensive credit limits.
算力平台月度词元消耗量和企业运营、收入、未来收款等环环相扣、彼此印证: The computing power platform's monthly token consumption and enterprises' operations, revenue, and future collections interlock and verify each other.
李柳兰表示，针对可能存在的词元消耗数据造假情况，银行在具体业务开展过程中，强化业: Li Liulan stated that in response to potential risks of token consumption data falsification, banks will strengthen the verification of business authenticity during concrete business operations, establish a cross-verification mechanism combining "contract + token invocation data + transaction records," connect with enterprises' computing power platform token metering data, verify the entire chain of token production, invocation, and settlement, verify the authenticity of accounts and payments, and prevent risks such as fabricated computing power business, invalid customer swiping calls, and inflated token revenue.
未来还将争取与算力平台企业建立合作关系，向银行开放算力平台系统查询ID，实现实时: In the future, efforts will also be made to establish cooperative relationships with computing power platform enterprises, open computing power platform system query IDs to banks, achieve real-time monitoring and verification, strengthen data authenticity management, and prevent falsification risks.
李柳兰坦言，“词元贷”仍在探索阶段，还没有成熟的风控模型，有待在政策支持下持续加: Li Liulan acknowledged candidly that the 'Token Loan' is still in the exploratory stage and does not yet have a mature risk control model, requiring continuous strengthening of government-bank cooperation and bank-enterprise collaboration under policy support to explore various service models adapted to computing power industry development in different scenarios.
目前，广州地区已授信的算力企业以信用类贷款为主，并纳入广州市信贷风险机制政银风险: At present, computing power enterprises in the Guangzhou region that have been granted credit lines are primarily credit-based loans, which have been included in Guangzhou's credit risk mechanism government-bank risk-sharing framework.
目前，中国银行广州海珠支行“词元贷”授信总额已达2800万元，首批获授信企业广泛: Currently, the Bank of China Guangzhou Haizhu Branch's 'Token Loan' credit line has reached 28 million yuan, with the first batch of enterprises granted credit widely distributed in fields such as AI short dramas, e-commerce marketing, and artificial intelligence tool development, primarily comprising small and micro enterprises in the computing power industry chain.
但这是一个良好的开始，他认为，“词元贷”的深层效应在于对人工智能产业生态的撬动，: However, this is a good beginning. He believes that the deeper effect of the 'Token Loan' lies in leveraging the artificial intelligence industry ecosystem, with the government providing the platform, banks driving innovation, platforms supplying data, and service providers implementing solutions, thereby constructing a positive cycle of "financial empowerment—industrial clustering—new financial demand."
